segments.text: Ok so this is the sub-agents page for Vue with OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, umm, the page promises a live delegation log, but this section has no frontend code for it, just one line of text.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, umm, the common settings file and the Vue app around the chat, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. The supervisor should delegate and show a live log of the sub-agents, but, uh, it just replies in chat and no log shows up.
So basically, the page says you get a visible delegation log, but there's no Vue code for it, so the main part of the page can't be built.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
